## Introduction

This document explores NBA player game log data from the 2025-26 NBA season. The purpose of this exploration is to investigate player performance and identify useful numerical and graphical summaries that will later be incorporated into an interactive Shiny application.

## Setup

```{r}
library(tidyverse)
library(arrow)

nba <- read_parquet("data/nba_2025_26.parquet")

nba <- nba |>
  mutate(
    location = if_else(home, "Home", "Away")
  )
```

## Data Overview

```{r}
dim(nba)
names(nba)
glimpse(nba)
```
